propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no loop breaker: tool_step_limit is never set on the primary verify step, causing runaway tool-call cycles to exhaust the entire step budget without producing a verdict
When the agent enters a repeating tool-call cycle, it burns requests until exhaustion and is killed with no verdict, forcing use of the forbidden --force-close unattested close
The existing max_consecutive_repeat metric is blind to cycles of length >= 2, scoring a genuine 4-call cycle at 1 while healthy breadth scores 5, making it unsuitable as an actuator
A windowed distinct-ratio detector (window 24, trip <= 0.50, order-insensitive) correctly identifies pathological runs while never firing on healthy runs with >0.83 margins
Runaway loops must be routed to the tool-free finalizer via bounded recovery to emit a verdict on fresh per-criterion evidence, not on the poisoned history that looped
Both kill paths (request_limit and tool_calls_limit) must be bounded as failure conditions without introducing a workload ceiling that truncates legitimate large-ticket evidence gathering
